title: 第三章    牺牲小我，进入轮回
content_zh:
两天后，王琼携六女站在学校操场中央。陪同在他们身边的还有银河之主，和王琼的父母。

    天依旧是白茫茫的一片，丝毫没有生机，到处残垣断壁，家园被毁，人们无家可归。望着人们脸上痛苦的表情，王琼心里很痛，他知道，他是时候该离开了，离开他所轮回九世的位面，不仅仅如此，这也是他没有成为宇宙之主前生活的地方，他爱地球，他爱这，生他养他的地方，但为了地球能恢复，他不得不离开。

    “是时候了，我该离开了，弟弟，照顾好爸妈还有你的嫂子们，还有你也不许跟着我一起轮回，你还没达到那个境界，等你达到境界后，你自然会去轮回，弟弟，光明宇宙交于你手，在我不在的这段时间了，光明宇宙就由你守护了，我相信你一定行的！爸妈，云儿，雪儿，倩儿，秀儿，丽丹，莹儿你们保重，我走了，”话完。王琼的身体逐渐飞升，飞到空中的王琼，俯视着大地。

    “地球的劫难因我琼霄而起，也就由我来结束，佛曰:我不入地狱，谁入地狱！以我之身，以我血液，以我之灵魂，重铸地球原貌！”话音一落王琼身体逐渐化为点点星光，四处飞散。

    “哥，我会好好守护光明，直到你王者归来的那一天，你放心的去吧！”银河之主说道。

    “琼霄哥哥，保重！”

    “孩子，你就放心的去吧，你老爸老妈很坚强的，我们为你骄傲！”

    王琼笑了，他笑得很开心！终于可以放心的去了。“想我琼霄历经无数历练，我倒要看看，我所去的位面会有怎样的精彩，即便我的记忆被封！我也要闯出一片天！充满未知的位面，我来了，此生无憾，来生我欲凌天，我定凌天！”话音一落，王琼消失而去。

    随着王琼消失，一道阳光划破白茫茫的天际，出现在了人们面前，阳光所到之处，地面逐渐恢复，山川相继出现，飞禽走兽也开始出现，高楼大厦陆续拔地而起，逝去的人们又重新出现，地球又重新焕发生机，对于人们来说，这就是一个噩梦，梦醒了，所有都结束了，人们又如往常一样上班，丝毫没有一点害怕的样子。

    “小弟，你哥哥轮回去了，我们也要跟着他去，光明宇宙交给你了，你要经常回宇宙之巅看看！”薛云拍了拍银河之主的肩膀。

    “可，嫂子，你们不是答应大哥，不去寻他吗，你们怎么又要去啊，以后大哥回来又要说我了，不行，反正我不同意，”银河之主担忧的说道。

    “我就说嘛。大姐怎么可能不让我们去找琼霄哥哥呢！弟弟，听嫂子们的话，可以吗？叔叔阿姨，你们应该不会拦我们吧？”王倩兴奋道。

    “弟弟，爸妈，你们知道的，我们爱琼霄，如果他不在我们身边，我们是不会快乐的，之所以之前对他说我们不会去找他，那是为了让他安心，不管怎样，我们都要去找他，你们就同意了吧！”薛云摇了摇头。

    “哎，丫头，我也不知道该怎么说你们，你们想去就去吧，我不会拦你们的，去了那也好有个照应。”王琼父亲叹息道。

    看着王琼消失的地方，薛云眼神迷离：“若是有一天 你不在身边 ，即使天再蔚蓝 哪怕阳光依旧会洒满窗前，我也不会感到快乐；若是有一天 ，你不在我身旁，我世界的春天不会再来，花也不会重开；曾记得 那条街道 有一个如风少年曾牵着我牵手走过那青石板，依稀中恍如昨日；若是有一天， 风不再经过 ，落叶该如何飘向远方 ，若是有一天 ，终不能怀念——你是否笑容依然；终将有一天，风不再经过，落叶从此便，不再流浪终；将有一天，永不能相见 ，留给我一世牵绊， 留给我 一世牵绊 ”。
content_en:
Two days later, Wang Qiong and her six girls stood in the middle of the school playground. Accompanying them were the Lord of the Galaxy and Wang Qiong's parents.

    The sky is still a vast expanse of white, lifeless at all, with ruins everywhere, homes destroyed, and people homeless. Looking at the painful expressions on people's faces, Wang Qiong's heart hurt. He knew that it was time for him to leave, leaving the plane where he had been reincarnated for nine lifetimes. Not only that, this was also the place where he lived before becoming the Lord of the Universe. He loved the earth, he loved this, the place where he was born and raised, but in order for the earth to recover, he had to leave.

    "It's time, I should leave, brother, take care of your parents and your sisters-in-law, and you are not allowed to reincarnate with me. You haven't reached that state yet. When you reach the state, you will naturally go to reincarnation. Brother, light The bright universe is in your hands. During my absence, you will protect the bright universe. I believe you can do it! Parents, Yun'er, Xue'er, Qian'er, Xiu'er, Lidan, and Ying'er, take care. I'm leaving." Wang Qiong's body gradually ascended, and Wang Qiong flew into the air, looking down at the earth.

    "The disaster of the earth started because of me, Qiong Xiao, and it will end with me. Buddha said: If I don't go to hell, who will! With my body, my blood, and my soul, I will reshape the earth's original appearance!" As soon as Wang Qiong finished speaking, his body gradually turned into little stars, flying everywhere.

    "Brother, I will protect the light well until the day when your king returns. You can go with peace of mind!" said the Lord of the Galaxy.

    "Brother Qiongxiao, take care!"

    "Child, just go with peace of mind. Your parents are very strong. We are proud of you!"

    Wang Qiong smiled, he smiled very happily! I can finally go there with peace of mind. "I think I, Qiong Xiao, have gone through countless experiences. I want to see how exciting the plane I go to will be. Even if my memory is blocked! I will break out of the sky! A plane full of unknowns. I am here. I have no regrets in this life. In the next life, I want to reach the sky, and I will reach the sky!" As soon as the voice fell, Wang Qiong disappeared.

    As Wang Qiong disappeared, a ray of sunlight cut through the white sky and appeared in front of people. Wherever the sunlight went, the ground gradually recovered, mountains and rivers appeared one after another, birds and animals began to appear, high-rise buildings began to rise one after another, the dead people reappeared, and the earth was rejuvenated. For people, this was a nightmare. When they woke up from the dream, everything was over, and people went to work as usual, without any fear at all.

    "Little brother, your brother has reincarnated, and we have to follow him. The bright universe is entrusted to you. You must go back to the top of the universe often!" Xue Yun patted the Lord of the Galaxy on the shoulder.

    "But, sister-in-law, didn't you promise eldest brother not to go look for him? Why are you going again? In the future, eldest brother will talk to me again when he comes back. No, I don't agree anyway," the Lord of the Galaxy said worriedly.

    "That's what I'm saying. How could the eldest sister not let us go find Brother Qiongxiao? Brother, can you listen to your sisters-in-law? Uncle and aunt, you won't stop us, right?" Wang Qian said excitedly.

    "Brother, parents, you know, we love Qiong Xiao. If he is not with us, we will not be happy. The reason why we told him before that we will not go to him is to make him feel at ease. No matter what, we will go to him, so you just agree!" Xue Yun shook his head.

    "Hey, girl, I don't know what to say to you. If you want to go, just go. I won't stop you. It's good to have someone to take care of you when you go there." Wang Qiong's father sighed.

    Looking at the place where Wang Qiong disappeared, Xue Yun's eyes were blurred: "If one day you are not by my side, even if the sky is blue and the sun is still shining in front of the window, I will not feel happy; if one day, you are not by my side, the spring of my world will not come again, and the flowers will not bloom again; I remember that there was a windy young man on that street who once held my hand and walked across the bluestone, vaguely as if it was yesterday; if one day, the wind no longer passes by. , how should the fallen leaves float into the distance, if one day, I will never miss you - will your smile still remain? There will come a day when the wind will no longer pass by, and the fallen leaves will no longer wander forever; There will be a day when we will never see each other, leaving me with a lifelong bond, leaving me with a lifelong bond."
title_en: Chapter 3 Sacrifice the ego and enter reincarnation
